.xt-root::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -100%; left: 0;
  width: 100%; height: 100px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, rgba(255, 62, 62, 0.08), transparent);

.xt-content::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  top: -30px; left: 40%;
  width: 80px; height: 30px;
  background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
  backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
  transform: rotate(-15deg);
  z-index: 100;
